reasons: H3: Complete existence and structure of relaxed BV minimizers with partial free boundary, beyond the already qualified convexification result2278. Given the direct method and cited interior minimal-graph regularity, the author still has to construct countably iterated symmetric Plateau replacements along free arcs without energy increase, control traces at convex boundaries, rule out partial contact with a curved Dirichlet arc by replacement competitors (including infinitely many contact components), handle the all-or-nothing straight-segment contact alternative, and obtain a minimizer with finitely many disjoint analytic free curves. The new counted goal is full boundary/free-boundary structure and regular existence, not a second copy of convexification. The general convex-domain relaxed theorem and strictly convex-domain classical corollary are one result family.

H3: Equivalence between the non-parametric partial-free-boundary minimization and the classical disk/annulus Plateau problem, including the two-disk degeneration. Even given Meeks-Yau existence, ordinary BV/perimeter facts and the cited Steiner equality theorem, the annulus case requires topology-driven simple connectedness of the projection, construction of the enclosed finite-perimeter region and a genuine annular parametrization of its symmetrized boundary, continuity through vertical tangent slices, and a rigidity argument forcing exactly two vertical intersections and opposite graph heights. The resulting original surface is itself symmetric and Cartesian, not merely a competitor of no larger area. Both directions and the strict area-gap/equality alternatives belong to one n=1,2 correspondence family; the easy disk case and helper lemmas are not separate counts.
